name: Canva
description_en:
Canva is a visual design and collaboration platform for social graphics, presentations, documents, video, print and websites. It combines templates, licensed stock content, user uploads, brand tools and AI assistance. Teams should evaluate the editable design, the exported deliverable and the rights to its component assets separately.

Free use is available, while Pro, Business and Enterprise add different content, brand, storage, collaboration and AI entitlements. The public pricing read in a normal browser localized to Chinese and Singapore dollars; those amounts are a regional snapshot, not a universal quote or a verified price for a particular account.
description_zh:
Canva是视觉设计及协作平台，涵盖社交图、演示、文档、视频、印刷及网站，组合模板、许可素材、用户上传、品牌工具和AI辅助。团队应分别评估可编辑设计、导出交付物及组成资产权利。

可持续免费使用，Pro、Business及Enterprise增加不同素材、品牌、存储、协作及AI权益。正常浏览器实读价格自动本地化为中文及新加坡元，金额只是区域快照，不是全球统一或某账户已确认报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine licensed content and original assets in an editable design, then export the format needed for the task.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可将许可内容及原创资产组合为可编辑设计，再按任务导出格式。

core_features.explanation_en: The read plan cards distinguish brand-kit quantities, approval features and enterprise SSO/SCIM; actual roles require configuration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 实读套餐区分品牌套件数量、审批及企业SSO/SCIM，实际角色仍需配置。

core_features.explanation_en: A subscription grants defined uses of library content rather than ownership or unrestricted resale of every stock asset.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订阅授予素材库内容的规定用途，不转让每项素材所有权或无限转售权。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Plan the editable source and final output together
sections.title_zh: 同时规划可编辑源稿及最终输出
sections.en:
For an illustrative event campaign, select a relevant design size/template, replace text and images with approved material, apply the intended brand settings and inspect the final layout. Keep the editable design in the appropriate account/team and export the required delivery files. The read comparison table includes PDF, JPG and PNG across plans, and places print/CMYK export in paid plans. That is a plan entitlement statement, not proof that a particular printer, file or color profile works.

Check layout, text wrapping, fonts, image quality and destination requirements using a real sample. An exported image is not the editable design; an imported PDF or a related application in the wider suite should not be assumed to preserve every original object or entitlement. No design, download, print order or website publication was performed.
sections.zh:
例如活动宣传，可选目标尺寸/模板、替换获准文字及图片、应用品牌设置并检查最终布局；将可编辑设计留在合适账户/团队，再导出所需文件。实读对比表在各档包含PDF、JPG及PNG，将印刷/CMYK导出放在付费版。这是套餐权益描述，不证明某印厂、文件或色彩配置可用。

应以真实样本检查布局、换行、字体、图质及目标要求。导出图像不是可编辑设计，导入PDF或套件内其他应用也不保证保留全部原对象或权益。本次未设计、下载、下印刷单或发布网站。

sections.title_en: Read the price with its currency, term and seat unit
sections.title_zh: 按币种、周期及席位理解价格
sections.en:
The observed annual pricing view displays Free S$0, Pro S$165 per person/year and Business S$250 per person/year; Enterprise uses sales contact. These are Singapore-dollar figures from a Chinese-language public page, not an offer for China priced in RMB. The Terms state that prices vary by location and actual billing information. Monthly prices, taxes and a final checkout were not verified in this research, so normalized price/currency fields remain unset.

The same cards show Free 5 GB storage and one 3-color brand kit, Pro 100 GB and 5 kits, Business 500 GB and 100 kits with approvals, and Enterprise 1 TB and 1,000 kits with layered/multi-team governance. Confirm the exact seat count and contract, especially where a feature has Coming Soon or other qualifications. Enterprise priority/dedicated success support is qualified on the page for contracts above 150 seats. Do not turn a paid-content count or suite logo into unlimited access to every asset/app.
sections.zh:
实读年付视图显示Free每人每年S$0、Pro S$165、Business S$250，Enterprise联系销售。这是中文公共页显示的新加坡元，不是中国市场人民币报价；条款也称价格随区域及实际账单信息变化。本次未核实月付、税及最终结账，因此规范化月价/币种字段仍留空。

卡片另列Free5GB及一个3色品牌套件、Pro100GB及5套件、Business500GB及100套件带审批、Enterprise1TB及1,000套件带分级/多团队治理。需确认席位数及合同，尤其有Coming Soon等限定的功能；企业优先/专属成功支持在页面限定超过150签约席位。素材数量或套件logo不表示每项资产/应用无限访问。

sections.title_en: Treat AI allowances and seat billing as separate meters
sections.title_zh: 分别看待AI额度及席位账单
sections.en:
The pricing cards describe shared AI allowances with different consumption for tool tiers and task complexity. Their Free up-to 20 uses and paid-plan multipliers are estimates for lower-cost/simple tasks, not a guaranteed number of arbitrary generation calls. Pro/Business can buy AI add-ons, and Business also lists top-ups. Read the selected account’s remaining allowance, reset period and applicable AI terms before budgeting a production workflow.

The effective August 19, 2026 Terms say recurring plans renew automatically. Team seats follow Pay as You Grow:monthly subscriptions reconcile at the next monthly renewal, while annual subscriptions reconcile every 3 months; removing already-paid seats does not generate a refund/credit. Cancellation takes effect at the current cycle’s end, generally without refund except required rights. Trials have eligibility/duration conditions and can convert to paid unless cancelled. No seat, subscription, AI or payment action was executed.
sections.zh:
价格卡片描述共享AI额度，不同工具等级和任务复杂度消耗不同；Free最多20次及付费倍数是基于低消耗/简单任务的估计，不保证任意生成调用次数。Pro/Business可购AI附加，Business还列充值；预算生产流程前需读实际账户剩余额度、刷新周期及AI条款。

2026年8月19日生效条款称周期套餐自动续约，团队席位按Pay as You Grow计算：月付在下次月续费核算，年付每3个月核算；移除已付款席位不产生退款/抵扣。取消在本账期末生效，通常不退款但保留法定权利。试用有资格/期限条件，未取消可转付费。本次未操作席位、订阅、AI或付款。

sections.title_en: Check the specific content category, not just a paid badge
sections.title_zh: 检查具体素材类别，不能只看付费标记
sections.en:
The Content License Agreement grants defined nonexclusive uses of library content. Pro Content licenses are issued per design on export; an active subscription can issue a new license for a new design, but the stock asset itself is not transferred for standalone redistribution. Client handoff of a design has conditions including a written agreement and transfer to one client for that client’s use.

The most restrictive category in a mixed design governs. Branded/Educationcontent and Popular Musichave special limitations, and the explanatory page distinguishes Education Pro content’s noncommercial use from ordinary commercial work. It also cautions against assuming a library-based logo is exclusive or trademark-ready. Use original graphics where exclusivity matters and check fonts, shapes and the actual asset’s terms. A paid content subscription does not provide trademark registration or infringement clearance.
sections.zh:
内容许可协议授予素材库规定的非独占用途。Pro Content按设计在导出时发许可，有效订阅可为新设计发新许可，但素材本身不转让用于单独再分发。客户交稿有书面协议、仅转给一个客户自用等条件。

混合设计适用最严格类别，Branded/Education内容及Popular Music有特殊限制；说明页也区分Education Pro素材非商业用途与普通商业工作，并提醒不能假定素材库logo独占或可注册商标。需要独占时应使用原创图形，并核对字体、形状及实际素材条款。购买付费素材访问不提供商标注册或侵权清理。

sections.title_en: Keep exported assets within their online-use conditions
sections.title_zh: 让导出资产符合网络使用条件
sections.en:
For unedited Pro Content in certain online publications, the agreement specifies a 480,000-pixelmaximum per content file, with exceptions for the dedicated Canva Websitepublish endpoint and Canva-hosted designs embedded elsewhere. This is not a universal pixel cap on every edited Canva design. Standalone stock redistribution, extractable assets and template resale also have conditions; the explanatory article is helpful but the actual content/source category matters.

A practical handoff checklist is to retain asset/source information, confirm commercial rights for uploads, identify any music/education/branded elements, and check whether the deliverable is an export, an embed or a client-editable design. Do not assume that a paid library license covers stock-font installation outside Canva or every music advertising channel. These are selected license observations, not individualized legal advice.
sections.zh:
对某些网络出版物中的未编辑Pro Content，协议规定每个素材文件最多480,000像素，专用Canva Website发布终端及Canva托管嵌入设计有例外，并非全部已编辑Canva设计的统一像素上限。独立素材再分发、可提取资产及模板转售也有条件，应核对实际内容/来源类别，不能仅看概述。

交接可保留素材/来源信息、确认上传商用权、识别音乐/教育/品牌内容，并区分导出、嵌入或交给客户编辑的设计。不能假定付费素材许可包含Canva外安装素材字体或所有音乐广告渠道。上述为选定许可观察，不是个别法律意见。

sections.title_en: Choose the account that should control the working design
sections.title_zh: 选择应控制工作设计的账户
sections.en:
The Terms distinguish user uploads from licensed library material and reserve Canva’ssoftware/service IP. They also allow an organization to administer a managed-email account and allow team administrators to control, transfer or delete associated content/designs. That matters when handing over a client project or separating personal work from an employer/team account. Shared credentials are not an appropriate substitute for separate users.

AI-improvement use of general usage/User Content is tied to privacy settings in the Terms, and Education User Content has a separate no-training statement. This is not a verified universal no-training or regional-retention promise for every account/app. Pilot the actual share/edit/export permissions and departure handoff, confirm data/AI settings and keep required outputs. No account, team, permission, AI training setting or recovery was tested.
sections.zh:
条款区分用户上传与许可素材，并保留Canva软件/服务知识产权；也允许机构管理使用机构邮箱的账户，以及团队管理员控制、转移或删除相关内容/设计。客户交稿或分开个人/雇主团队工作时，这会影响控制权，共享密码不应替代独立用户。

条款将一般使用数据/User Content用于AI改进与隐私设置关联，Education User Content另有不训练声明，不能当作每种账户/应用均不训练或固定区域保留保证。应试点实际分享/编辑/导出权限和离职交接、确认数据/AI设置并保留所需输出。本次未测试账户、团队、权限、AI训练设置或恢复。
